Welcome to our brand-new YouTube channel 👋

We’ve created this space to share longer videos, special moments, and behind-the-scenes footage from Woodfield Animal Sanctuary.

Our main social media platform has always been Facebook, and that’s where we post the majority of our regular updates, news, and appeals. YouTube gives us the opportunity to bring you along in a different way — through video — while still keeping Facebook as the heart of our day-to-day communication.

If you’re new here, thank you for finding us.
If you already follow us on Facebook, welcome — and thank you for your continued support.

By liking, subscribing, and sharing our videos, you help us reach more people and continue giving animals the second chances they deserve.

PLEASE VISIT OUR FACEBOOK PAGE FOR REGULAR UPDATES 
WOODFIELD ANIMAL SANCTUARY.
